name: maintenance
description: Workflow tong hop maintenance he thong Viezan, gom diagnostics, duplicate/hardcode, score-code, UI component split, extension drift, docs drift, i18n/security/perf gates, fix va report co section bat buoc.

classification.use_for: Use as the canonical maintenance workflow instead of asking users to choose individual maintenance workflows.

trigger: Khi user yeu cau maintenance he thong, bao tri codebase, fix technical debt, hoac muon AI tu danh gia va sua cac van de chat luong.

required_gate_matrix.required_evidence: Branch, submodule state, dirty files relevant to maintenance and excluded unrelated changes.
Command/status table with exact failures or pass counts.
Weighted score table: Correctness, Architecture, Security, Reliability, Code Quality, Maintainability, Testing, Performance, Documentation.
Counts by clone type, top candidates with file:line pairs or an explicit clean result with scan scope.
Counts by credential, magic number/string, config, URL, UI value and icon categories; include false-positive notes.

required_gate_matrix.source: split-ui-component and audit-extension-ux when extension is in scope
required_gate_matrix.required_evidence: Component map summary, inline SVG/icon results, duplicate UI pattern results and extension drift results.
Docs drift result, locale parity/hardcoded UI text result and local-first IPC/key boundary result.

required_gate_matrix.source: audit-live-perf when live/audio/streaming/timer code is in scope
required_gate_matrix.required_evidence: Lifecycle/perf risk result or Not run with reason.

required_gate_matrix.source: release-readiness when package/version/CI/release assets are in scope
required_gate_matrix.required_evidence: Release gate result or Not run with reason.

steps.name: Xac dinh maintenance scope
steps.action: Doc user request, git status, recent reports trong viezanagent/report va viezanagent/fix. Mac dinh scope: src/, electron/, chrome-extension/, docs, .github/, package/config files va agent assets. Khong reset dirty changes khong thuoc task. Khoi tao Maintenance Gate Matrix voi tat ca gate required truoc khi chay scan.

steps.name: Diagnostics gate
steps.action: Chay hoac tieu thu output tu TypeScript, build, tests, Biome/VS Code Problems; dung fix-vscode-problems de phan loai root cause.
steps.policy: Neu command fail do network/cache package, ghi ro environment blocker thay vi gan loi code.

steps.name: Code quality va hardcode audit
steps.action: Dung check-dup-hardcode va score-code de tim duplicate, hardcode, magic literals, secrets, maintainability debt va quality regression. Ket qua score-code, duplicate va hardcode phai thanh 3 section rieng trong report.

steps.name: UI va docs gates
steps.action: Dung split-ui-component cho UI/icon/extension drift; dung audit-extension-ux neu chrome-extension/ nam trong scope; dung sync-docs/viezan-doc-sync de kiem tra docs va agent classification drift.

steps.name: System gates
steps.action: Chay audit-i18n-coverage khi co UI text/locale/extension; chay audit-local-first-security khi cham IPC/preload/provider/key/local server; chay audit-live-perf khi cham live/audio/stream/timer/listener; chay release-readiness khi scope lien quan package/release. Gate khong chay phai co Not run/Blocked + ly do.

steps.name: Uu tien findings
steps.action: Sap xep Critical/High truoc. Critical security/secret/build break/core flow break phai fix hoac block. Medium/Low dua vao Remaining Queue neu ngoai scope.

steps.name: Apply fixes
steps.action: Sua truc tiep cac finding Critical/High trong scope; giu fix hep, khong redesign neu khong can; cap nhat report/fix artifacts lien quan.

steps.name: Verify
steps.action: Chay lai commands lien quan toi phan da sua; validate JSON/Markdown agent assets neu co thay doi viezanagent.

steps.name: Report
steps.action: Luu report tong hop gom tat ca required sections va Report Completeness Checklist. Khong duoc gop System Score, Duplicate Code Audit, Hardcode & Secret Audit va UI/Component/Extension Audit vao Findings chung.

dup_hardcode_tables: Duplicate counts by clone type and severity
Hardcode counts by category and severity
Top 3 prioritized findings or explicit clean result
completion_checklist: All required gates appear in Maintenance Gate Matrix
Every required section exists even when clean
Skipped gates use Not run/Blocked with reason
Commands or scanned scopes are recorded
Critical/High findings are fixed or blocked with owner/next action

completion_rules: Report thieu System Score, Duplicate Code Audit, Hardcode & Secret Audit hoac UI/Component/Extension Audit thi xem la incomplete.
Khong xem `Info: no secret found` la thay the cho Hardcode & Secret Audit; phai ghi scope, patterns/commands va false positives.
Khong xem `Icon policy has no High violation` la thay the cho UI/Component/Extension Audit; phai co component/UI/extension scope.
Neu chi chay diagnostics/package audit, phai ket luan report chua hoan tat thay vi ghi maintenance pass.
Report cuoi cung phai tu review bang Report Completeness Checklist truoc khi tra loi user.
